channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Karl Malone | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Karl Malone from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on Charles Barkley, Karl Malone
item.description:
“The reason why I would pick Karl Malone over Charles is because of the level of professionalism that Karl Malone always approached,”

Richard Jefferson on Charles Barkley, Karl Malone, Aug 4, 2025. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Julius Erving on Karl Malone, Tim Duncan, Tiny Archibald
item.description:
Erving struggled to name the last player on his top 10 list.

“I always argue with my son [about] where Tim Duncan belongs, and he's like, 'He belongs ahead of Karl Malone for sure.' I'm taking Karl Malone and that last position... I like Tiny Archibald,”

Julius Erving on Karl Malone, Tim Duncan, Tiny Archibald, Jul 30, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: John Stockton on Karl Malone
item.description:
John Stockton:

“Just one thing after another. Just kind of bond, bond, bond, bond to where now he is literally inseparable for me as a brother. We don’t see each other every day. We talk occasionally on the phone. That term is probably overused, but there’s nothing I wouldn’t do for Karl Malone, and I think he feels the same way.”

John Stockton on Karl Malone, Mar 25, 2022. Source: YouTube.

item.title: LeBron James on Karl Malone, John Stockton
item.description:
Lakers'LeBron James on Jazz as last two all-star picks:

“There’s no slander to the Utah Jazz. You’ve got to understand, just like in video games growing up, we never played with Utah. As great as Karl Malone and John Stockton was, we would never pick those guys in video games.”

LeBron James on Karl Malone, John Stockton, Mar 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Mychal Thompson on Karl Malone, Reggie Miller
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Mychal Thompson on Klay's high school recruitment:

“He was very skinny. He made Reggie Miller look like Karl Malone. That's how skinny Klay was in high school ... so a lot of the Pac-12 schools didn't really take him seriously.”

Mychal Thompson on Karl Malone, Reggie Miller, Mar 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Karl Malone, John Stockton, Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Eric Walden:Rudy Gobert, on he and Donovan as a new Stockton and Malone of sorts:

“That’s the kind of legacy we hope to leave behind us when it’s all said and done. And hopefully win championships. It’s just great to have those two guys paving the way for us.”

Rudy Gobert on Karl Malone, John Stockton, Donovan Mitchell, Feb 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: DeShawn Stevenson on Jerry Sloan, Karl Malone, John Stockton, John Starks
item.description:
DeShawn Stevenson on his high-school-to-NBA transition:

“Mine was tough. I feel like I had to grind harder. I didn’t get the same chances as most straight-out-of-high-school guys. I went to a team that had been to the Finals two years in a row and was trying to compete for a championship and they had John Stockton, Karl Malone, Byron Russell and John Starks. We had seasoned vets, so I didn’t play that much. Also, I had a coach who was hard-nosed in Jerry Sloan; he didn’t play any games. I came out of high school and was flashy, so it was an adjustment. I kind of got stereotyped… It was tough, man. Sometimes I would get picked on really bad...”

DeShawn Stevenson on Jerry Sloan, Karl Malone, John Stockton, John Starks, Mar 19, 2019. Source: audioBoom.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Karl Malone
item.description:
Donovan Mitchell on passing Karl Malone’s Jazz rookie postseason single-game scoring record with 33 points:

“I’m not really trying to think about that now. You have bigger things to worry about right now as a team.”

Donovan Mitchell on Karl Malone, Apr 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @E_Woodyard.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson, Karl Malone, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
“I played with Michael Jordan when he was 39 he played 37 minutes a night. Karl Malone was 37, played 38 minutes a night, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Magic Johnson, Kobe. Everybody's built different. If you're one of the greats, sometimes you've got to play, sometimes you get rest like tonight.”

Tyronn Lue on Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson, Karl Malone, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Nov 21, 2017. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Jason Terry on Karl Malone
item.description:
“Karl Malone, he cemented his legacy in Utah, no doubt. But again, when you win a championship, and you still produce the way Dirk has over all these years and is still riding it out -- even in the tough times -- hey, everybody’s entitled to their own opinion. But that’s just me.”

Jason Terry on Karl Malone, Oct 13, 2017. Source: unifyfrisco.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Karl Malone, John Stockton
item.description:
Doc Rivers:

“I always use Utah as a great (example). Thank God Karl Malone and (John) Stockton didn't listen to people, you know what I mean? They fell (in the playoffs), and kept trying and kept trying. And finally, late in their careers, they finally broke through to the Finals. They didn't win it (all). But you know, that's the pursuit. I just think it's so easy to (say), 'Hey, they should break up,' from the outside. And I think that's such an easy opinion.”

Doc Rivers on Karl Malone, John Stockton, Apr 17, 2017. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Charles Barkley, Karl Malone, John Stockton
item.description:
“But on the flip side, if you're able to stay healthy, there's a level of confidence and relief that comes with having a ring already. Especially these days. There's such a burden and a stigma on players and teams that have not won the big one. You can name any of the above superstars. You see their name attached, whether it's Charles Barkley or whoever, [John] Stockton and [Karl] Malone, oh, they didn't win the big one. I mean, come on, they were some of the greatest players of all time and had phenomenal runs. But winning the big one these days, it lifts a burden.”

Steve Kerr on Charles Barkley, Karl Malone, John Stockton, Jun 6, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Anthony Mason on Karl Malone, John Stockton
item.description:
Anthony Mason on Jan 23, 2015:

“I could get rebounds on anybody. As far as the toughest player to probably guard, that gave a little of difficulty, and it was maybe because of his point guard [John Stockton], was Karl Malone.”

Anthony Mason on Karl Malone, John Stockton, Mar 7, 2015. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Gary Payton on Michael Jordan, Karl Malone
item.description:
Gary Payton:

“Those battles were a little easier. I would have Jordan get mad at me and go back at me. He knew he was really talented and could do whatever he wanted to. But [Stockton] was more of a challenge to me than guarding someone that would talk back to me. When you talk back to me and say something to me it made my game go to another level. John was one who wouldn't say nothing and you couldn't figure him out. He'd keep going in the pick and rolls and he and Karl Malone would score a big bucket. At times I would guard Jordan and get him mad and into other things.”

Gary Payton on Michael Jordan, Karl Malone, Sep 2, 2013. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Karl Malone
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Cuban:

“Karl Malone won an MVP at 35. Maybe Dirk won't win an MVP, but trust me, Dirk can still play.”

Mark Cuban on Karl Malone, Jul 22, 2013. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.
